title: US Justice Dept tells staff to call AI 'super intelligence' under Trump order
key_facts: A top Trump administration official told the Justice Department to adopt Trump's rebranding of AI as 'super intelligence' or 'SI', per four people familiar with the matter (NBC News, 6 Oct 2026).
Reuters and Bloomberg Law headlines of 6 Oct carry the same development; Bloomberg Law's says staff must use the term in court.
MediaNama reported that Trump signed an order on 29 Sep 2026 telling agencies to use 'superintelligence' instead of 'AI' in official communications.
quote_evidence: A top Trump administration official has told the Justice Department to adopt President Donald Trump's rebranding of artificial intelligence, or AI, as "super intelligence," or "SI," four people familiar with the matter told NBC News.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows the executive order's naming rule reaching the Justice Department.
notes: Reuters article returned 401; only NBC's lead paragraph was readable (rest of page was navigation), plus headlines of Reuters and Bloomberg Law and MediaNama's account of the order.
